meta.name: setup-cms
meta.description: Connect a CMS to notfair SEO tools. Guides users through configuring WordPress, Strapi, Contentful, or Ghost — tests the connection, and writes credentials to .env.local. Once set up, seo-analysis automatically cross- references CMS content against Google Search Console data. Use whenever the user says "connect my CMS", "set up WordPress", "configure Strapi", "add Contentful", "connect Ghost", or "CMS setup". Also trigger if the user asks why no CMS data appears in a seo-analysis report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 连接你的 CMS 到 SEO 工具，自动同步内容数据
copy.tagline_en: Connect your CMS to SEO tools and sync content data automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use WordPress, Strapi, Contentful, or Ghost and need SEO analysis

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你连接 WordPress、Strapi、Contentful 或 Ghost 等 CMS，测试连接并将凭据写入 .env.local 文件。之后，seo-analysis 技能会自动将 CMS 内容与 Google Search Console 数据进行交叉比对。
howto.when: 当你说“连接我的 CMS”、“设置 WordPress”、“配置 Strapi”、“添加 Contentful”、“连接 Ghost”或“CMS 设置”时触发。如果你问为什么 seo-analysis 报告中没有 CMS 数据，也会触发。

say.text: 连接我的 WordPress 网站
say.note: Claude 会引导你输入网址、用户名和应用密码。
Claude 会询问 Strapi 网址和 API 令牌。

say.text: 为什么 seo-analysis 没有显示 CMS 数据？
say.note: Claude 会检查 CMS 连接状态并引导设置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you to connect a CMS (WordPress, Strapi, Contentful, or Ghost), tests the connection, and writes credentials to .env.local. Once set up, seo-analysis automatically cross-references CMS content with Google Search Console data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "connect my CMS", "set up WordPress", "configure Strapi", "add Contentful", "connect Ghost", or "CMS setup". Also triggers if you ask why no CMS data appears in a seo-analysis report.

say_en.note: Claude will ask for URL, username, and app password.
Claude will ask for Strapi URL and API token.

say_en.text: Why doesn't seo-analysis show CMS data?
say_en.note: Claude checks CMS connection and guides setup.
